# SillyMaker

SillyMaker is a human–agent co-creation engine for GUI applications and games.
It organizes product intent into shared, inspectable artifacts and executable
acceptance: people define and refine the result, while coding agents implement
against the same ownership boundaries, runtime behavior, and definition of
done.

## Current boundary

- Current product targets: Browser and Deno Desktop preview.
- Current use: supported workspace package entries from a source checkout; the
  packages are not published to npm.
- Current authoring: ordinary TypeScript/React, structured Scene/content/layout
  documents, diagnostics, simulation, browser evidence, and a development
  Inspector with bounded Scene editing and read-only runtime facets.
- Direction, not a shipped claim: a broader shared editor surface for people
  and agents. SillyMaker is not yet a complete visual editor or no-code tool.

## Start with a shared brief

- Coding-agent start: ./start/
- Manual start: ./start/manual/
- Project structure: ./start/project-structure/

Define the complete user-visible scope, required screens/scenes/routes/content,
target devices and input, human-tuned areas, automated acceptance, manual
acceptance, and explicit exclusions before implementation. A vertical slice is
not completion unless the brief says it is the whole product.

## Choose a product path

- GUI application: ./guides/gui-application/
- Game: ./guides/game-application/
- Core concepts: ./concepts/

## Inspect and verify

- Layout and input: ./guides/layout-and-input/

- Build and publish: ./guides/build-and-publish/
- Package entries: ./reference/packages/
- Project configuration: ./reference/project-config/
- Data formats: ./reference/formats/

## Current examples

- Example roles and status: ./examples/
- One Last Sound Check, the maintained flagship VN Reference Product with 110 unique entries and two complete 82-entry routes: ./examples/vn-reference-tour/ (bundled site player: ./play/vn-reference-tour/)
- SillyOS Creator Preview, GUI-only Creator Home to Program Workspace with one built-in Agent Creator and a deterministic local preview; no real Pi, database, RPC, Mod activation, or persistence: ./examples/silly-os/ (bundled site player: ./play/silly-os/)
- Bookshop, focused narrative-authoring example: ./examples/bookshop/
